## Executive Summary
Fajar Iryanto Putra is a cross-disciplinary executive practitioner bridging clinical ophthalmic diagnostics with high-level software engineering. He has engineered, optimized, and deployed over 52 enterprise web applications and managed 77 total software projects across Health-Tech EMRs, Enterprise ERP & HRIS, Spatial PostGIS GIS systems, AI/AR vision pipelines, and PWA suites. Simultaneously, he actively practices as a Licensed Optometrist specializing in refractive surgery pre-op diagnostics (Lasik/PRK), Cataract biometry, OCT retinal analysis, Pentacam corneal topography, and Humphrey visual field screening.
